No door leaves, no portcullis. Do not join or overlap the two atlas cells.

assets.name: entrance-complete
assets.prompt: Create a COMPLETE freestanding open entrance arch for a Tibia 7.6 pixel-art temple. Image 1 is the exact geometry: a 128x64 logical-pixel arch with two strong pillars at the OUTER ends, a continuous top lintel across the entire width, stone feet, and an open transparent middle. Image 2 is the material reference: dark navy basalt, silver beveled edges, electric cyan circuit runes. Keep the first reference's complete silhouette and alignment EXACTLY; fill its frame with rich stone/metal texture, place one cyan diamond centered on the top beam. Two 64x64 halves must join seamlessly at the center, no gap, no floating separated pieces. Draw on the native coarse pixel grid, nearest-neighbor enlarged, crisp pixels, no blur or antialiasing. Genuine transparent background and opening. No doors, floor, people, extra objects, text, labels, shadows or haze. Entire arch fills the canvas edge to edge in the same 2:1 aspect as the first reference. This corrects an incomplete arch; both pillars and the continuous beam must be fully present.

Image 2 is the material style. Replace ivory stone with dark navy basalt steps, restrained silver-blue riser highlights, thin electric cyan light strips at the step edges and angular side trim. Crisp old-school native pixel art, visibly stepped square pixels on a 64x64 logical grid then nearest-neighbor enlarged, no antialiasing or blur. Transparent background outside the native silhouette, no floor, railing, characters, text, labels or extra props. Keep the orientation EXACTLY; do not rotate or mirror.
